title: Mr. Okello Fixes Cars
subtitle: Working Fathers of Soroti
author: Anthony Mwesigwa
description: Join Mr. Okello at his garage where he fixes cars, motorcycles, and trucks for the people of Soroti.
keywords: mechanic, garage, cars, Uganda, Soroti, family, work, father
dedication: For all the fathers who work with their hands to provide for their families.
authorBio: Anthony Mwesigwa is a passionate storyteller from Kampala, Uganda, dedicated to creating engaging educational books for young African readers.
backCoverText: What does a mechanic do? Join Mr. Okello as he fixes cars, solves problems, and uses his skills to help others. A story about hard work and honesty.
